weather.disclaimer: This is only a forecast and it can change. Check it again a few days before you travel.
weather.rainyTip: For rainy days we recommend Extreme Adventure: ATVs, buggies, ziplines and a cenote.

season.hurricane: You travel during hurricane season (June to November). Most days are sunny; check the forecast a few days before.
season.sargassum: From April to September sargassum can reach some Caribbean beaches. Cenotes are not affected.
